verses.verse:
अज्ञानात् संशयो व्याधिः शास्त्रे तस्यौषधिः स्थिता।
गुरूम् वैध्यम् समाश्रित्य सन्तुष्टः शान्तिमाप्नुयात्।१२२।
verses.text: Doubt born of ignorance is a disease, and its medicine lies in the śāstra. Taking refuge in the guru as physician, one becomes content and attains peace.

commentary.text: That is, because of ignorance many kinds of doubt arise in the mind. Doubt makes the mind sick. The medicine for this disease of doubt certainly lies in the śāstra (systematic treatise), but only by taking refuge in the physician who is the guru (teacher) can that doubt be removed. When doubt is removed, the mind attains peace.
